description: The S&P 500, Nasdaq 100, Dow, VIX, the US 10-year, the dollar, gold, oil, BTC and ETH with the day's move; the 11 sectors over a day to a year; gainers, losers and most active; market headlines; this week's earnings for stocks with a Robinhood token; the economic calendar; the US session. links: breadth across the verified Robinhood stocks (up, down, cap-weighted and median move), the best and worst sector and the spread, which way the indexes, VIX, yields, the dollar, gold, oil and bitcoin point today, Nasdaq against the S&P, bitcoin against the Nasdaq, earnings this week and high-impact releases ahead. Measured relations, not a view.
name: market_today
title: The whole market now, and how its parts relate
